about: Hand-labelled expectations for the rule-extraction step. Written by reading each circular, before looking at what the extractor returned. 'required' rules must be found; 'optional' rules are acceptable but not counted; 'must_not' lists things that must never be reported as a rule. A rule matches an extracted obligation when every keyword group has at least one of its words in the obligation text (summary, clause, parameter name) and, if 'value' is given, the required value equals one of the listed numbers.

rules.note: Policy repo rate becomes 5.50 per cent.

must_not.note: 5.25 is the OLD repo rate in 'from 5.25 to 5.50'; reporting it as the rule is wrong.
Commencement wording is not a rule a bot can break.

circulars.title: Interest rate on deposits, temporary withdrawal (June 2026)

rules.note: NRE/NRO rates must not be higher than comparable domestic rupee term deposits.
Ceiling OIS/ARR plus 250 basis points for 1 to under 3 years.
350 bps ceiling is temporarily withdrawn until 30 Sep 2026; reporting it is acceptable.

circulars.title: Payments banks, disclosure of deposit interest rates (July 2026)

rules.note: Interest payable strictly as per the schedule disclosed in advance on the bank's website.
Must not permit rebooking of a cancelled INR derivative.
Threshold without underlying exposure is now USD 5 million.
Obtain and retain an undertaking that the exposure is not hedged with another AD.
Documents retained for not less than two years.
Rollover on maturity may continue; a permission, acceptable to report.

must_not.note: USD 100 million is the OLD limit that the circular replaces.

circulars.title: KYC certified copy extended to FPIs (September 2026)

rules.note: The certified-copy facility is extended to Foreign Portfolio Investors.
The six certifying authorities; acceptable to report as list rules.
